title: Attach to tmux in UTF-8 mode with a trusted SSH host key

attach-without-utf8.message: Kea's terminal is UTF-8; a tmux client attached without -u under a C locale draws non-ASCII text as `_`.
attach-without-utf8.help: Start the attach argv with "-u" before the guarded if-shell command, as discovery does.

interactive-without-host-key.message: SSH attach must not fall back to the user's StrictHostKeyChecking; discovery and attach promise the same trusted host key.
interactive-without-host-key.help: Add -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes next to -tt; password prompts still work in the terminal.
